svg.title: Null models for the sample proportion when p = 0.50, with 100 adults and with 1,000 adults
svg.desc: Two normal curves centered at 0.50. For n = 100 (SE 0.05) the tails beyond 0.42 and 0.58 are shaded, total area about 0.11. For n = 1,000 (SE about 0.016) the curve is narrow and 0.58 is about 5 SE out, area below 0.0001.
svg.text: tail area too thin to see
Sample proportion p̂ who meet the guideline (hypothetical survey)
Each curve encloses a total area of 1; each is drawn to fit its panel.
